entities.name: Lê Ý Tông
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lê Ý Tông was the third-last emperor of the Vietnamese Lê dynasty, reigning only nominally under the power of Trịnh Giang of the Trịnh lords. He reigned from 1735 to 1740 and was succeeded by Lê Hiển Tông.
